title: Preflight model list from the OpenChamber API

source.method: PM decision 2026-11-26: read the model list from the OpenChamber API on port 38307 instead of the local binary. Never update the opencode binary. Never run the opencode CLI for the list.
source.evidence: spec.md EV1-EV5. The batch preflight at harness/batch.sh:362 calls opencode_host_run models --standalone. reports/batch-hungerg-free-2026w48.log shows exit 3 with 'opencode models does not list opencode-go/hungerg-free'. GET http://127.0.0.1:38307/api/model returned 470 entries on 2026-11-26; opencode-go/hungerg-free and opencode-go/hy4-flash-free are present with status active and enabled true.
